♬ Radio Shell - Terminal FM Radio Player

Listen to FM radio stations from Turkey and around the world directly from your terminal.
Built with Spring Boot 4, Java 25, and interactive shell commands.
Includes 45+ pre-configured stations, custom station support, favorites, and Docker support.

Features:
- 45+ Turkish and international FM stations
- Interactive terminal shell with color output
- Search and filter stations by country/genre
- Favorites and custom station management
- Docker & Docker Compose support
- Persistent configuration

Usage: ./radio.sh or ./docker-run.sh
